learning_objective: 🎯 Discover additional templates, career paths, and technical safety guidelines to apply your middle school vocational skills in real-world scenarios!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: An Annexure is a special section at the back of a book filled with handy resources. It stores charts, extra blueprints, report forms, and checklists that help you do your practical work easily.
This section provides pre-made logbooks and observation tables. You can use these templates to systematically track things like hydroponic water levels or home electricity consumption.

The annexure includes essential safety charts for handling tools, working around electricity, or mixing nutrient solutions. It serves as your quick-reference manual to prevent accidents in the workspace.

It helps you explore exciting career lines connected to what you learned. Reading through these references shows you how middle school skills can grow into careers in agriculture, design, or engineering.

fun_activity.title: 📝 Design Your Vocational Logbook
fun_activity.instructions: Look at the annexure patterns and design a clean, one-page observation chart in your notebook. Include columns for 'Date', 'Task Done', 'Tools Used', and 'Safety Check' to track your next practical project!

quick_recap: ⭐ The annexure contains valuable supplementary documents, project logbooks, and ready-to-use forms.
⭐ It acts as a safety and procedural reference to ensure safe hands-on learning.
⭐ It links classroom vocational lessons to real-world career paths and professional skills.
